# appsignal_app (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_app" "example" {
  name        = "my-example-app"
  environment = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) The environment of the app.
- `name` (String) The name of the app.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the app was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the app.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the app was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import appsignal_app.example "abcdef"
```
